modifications: Original mlx2 code. Only the idea of pricing a speculative round by the measured cost of its verify-window width is taken.

Applied to mlx2's existing copy-vs-head gate (tokens emitted per unit of round cost over a window of rounds), not to a depth selector: the measured table replaces the linear 1 + verify_row_cost * rows model; draft_step_cost still prices head drafting.
The table is operator-supplied (for example the verify-topology probe's row_cost_ms); linear between listed row counts, extended past the widest by its last slope, normalized by the one-row cost.
Default off (None); absent from as_dict and receipts when unset, so existing copy-draft identities are unchanged.
